ICC_poverty.coding: Two orthonormal Helmert contrasts, applied to every common area covariate including intercept; deviation columns multiplied by 0.75/2.5
ICC_poverty.priors: Existing ICC global intercept SD5, global slope SD2.5; contrast-coefficient SD0.75; no changed spatial/kappa prior
ICC_poverty.poor_stratum_information: Partial pooling remains defined even when a stratum has few sampled areas

same_information: All methods receive the same 14 article auxiliaries, fixed poverty labels, coordinates/neighbor graph, observed survey sample and sampling design; only the prespecified mathematical representation differs
poverty_requirement: Actual auxiliary poverty at the article cutpoints30/55; no arbitrary transform of old synthetic X1 into poverty

mixture.CDF: w*empiricalCDF(ICC marginal conditional-beta draws)+(1-w)*NormalCDF(SAR mean,SAR MSE)
mixture.uncertainty: Untruncated mixture-law 2.5/97.5percentiles; no exact design-coverage guarantee
mixture.saved_quantile_reconstruction: Forbidden; actual posterior marginal draws required
mixture.joint_endpoints: No joint endpoint law is asserted

development_selection.primary_criterion: IS95 averaged equally over contexts and endpoints, all same target areas
development_selection.population_holdout_audit: For each development world, choose recipe from all other worlds and score both endpoints of held-out world
development_selection.mixture_weight: One globally selected fixed weight; no per-endpoint or per-final-population optimization
development_selection.CUT8: Excluded from candidate family following previously adverse validation
development_selection.roles: Development approximation must be labelled; fresh evaluation uses original HMC gates and no recipe changes

scientific_claim: Candidate definition and numerical QA do not establish superiority; a separately frozen fresh comparison is required
